summary: The r46 normalized residual sum_K(L_K R_K/S_K)^2>2048 does not force any literal physical rank-three crossing, even together with the original rank-one overlap-two packet and failure of every |lambda_K|S_K>=2^-10 pair gate. A target-valid family with epsilon=2^-12 and m=2^41 has spectrum {1,+512,-512}, rank-one packet 1/128, normalized energy 65536, every pair scale sqrt(2)epsilon<2^-10, yet every physical coordinate crossing has rank at most two. This refutes only the proposed E3-only compiler, not QFORM. The replacement theorem routes bounded support degree through a pair-disjoint matching into physical Z3 or a quantitative rank-one/rank-two kernel-star image, leaving a necessary high-degree hub branch.
